DLC2305:4:t_005:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「So they are overwhelming us with numbers!」

DLC2305:4:t_006:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Is this as far as I go...!?」

DLC2305:4:t_006:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then I'll take as many enemies with me as I can...!」

DLC2305:4:t_007:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「The $$トールギス$$! $$ゼクス・マーキス$$!」

DLC2305:4:t_008:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$トレーズ$$ entrusted each of us with the future... You could call us comrades.」

DLC2305:4:t_008:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「You're right. Protecting this world will be my victory over him.」

DLC2305:4:t_008:5.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then I thank you again, $$ゼクス$$! You've reminded me of something important!」

DLC2305:4:t_008:7.en:
$$五飛$$
「The world $$トレーズ$$ gave his life to bring about...! I won't hand it over to the $$新地球皇国$$!」

DLC2305:4:t_010:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, you were deep in the mountains. No wonder we couldn't find you.」

DLC2305:4:t_010:3.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Without $$黎星刻$$'s help, it would have taken even longer.」

DLC2305:4:t_010:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Just as you suspect, $$ヒイロ$$. I was also looking for $$五飛$$ at his request.」

DLC2305:4:t_010:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We can talk later. Our enemies are waiting for us.」

DLC2305:4:t_011:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Attack target: $$新地球皇国$$. Mission objective: annihilation of the enemy force.」

DLC2305:4:t_011:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「With this much strength gathered, we have nothing to fear!」

DLC2305:4:t_011:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$新地球皇国$$! For burning that village, you'll receive the punishment you deserve!」

DLC2305:4:t_012:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「This would have happened sooner or later. That's why the villagers steeled themselves and decided to abandon it.」

DLC2305:4:t_012:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「And I will avenge their grief and anger.」

DLC2305:4:t_012:5.en:
$$五飛$$
「Did you come all this way for me?」

DLC2305:4:t_012:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We're not that free, you know...」

DLC2305:4:t_012:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's what I'd like to say, but the answer is yes.」

DLC2305:4:t_012:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「Someone asked us to come and bring you back.」

DLC2305:4:t_012:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$... $$ゼロ$$ is waiting for you.」

DLC2305:4:t_100:0.en:
$$五飛$$
（No battle lasts forever...! I believe that!）

DLC2305:4:t_100:1.en:
$$五飛$$
（To win that day... I'll become a sword for the powerless and keep fighting!）

DLC2305:4:t_101:0.en:
$$五飛$$
（$$トレーズ$$... I refuse to accept what you did.）

DLC2305:4:t_101:1.en:
$$五飛$$
（You should have lived and kept fighting until you saw peace in the world...!）

DLC2305:4:t_101:2.en:
$$五飛$$
（That's why I'll live...! Until the time comes to stake this life, I'll live and keep fighting!）

DLC2305:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
（My friend, $$トレーズ$$... Your soul has changed its form, living on within me, $$五飛$$, and so many others...）

DLC2305:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
（I too will keep fighting...! As your friend, $$ゼクス・マーキス$$, rather than $$ミリアルド・ピースクラフト$$!）

DLC2305:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$リリーナ$$... We'll end the fighting...）

DLC2305:4:t_103:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
（I'll leave guiding the world afterward to you and the others.）

DLC2305:4:t_104:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「All these battles against overwhelming odds remind me of my days as an agent from the colonies...!」

DLC2305:4:t_104:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Come on, Empire! I'll teach you in your bones that the God of Death is here on Earth!」

DLC2305:4:t_105:0.en:
$$トロワ$$
「There are still people in this world who keep fighting...」

DLC2305:4:t_106:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「We'll probably have no choice but to abandon this village...」

DLC2305:4:t_106:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「But we can't overlook the Empire's lawlessness! We'll crush the force they sent here!」

review.context: Zechs rescues Wufei and reminds him of their shared responsibility to Treize's future. The Gundam pilots arrive on Zero's behalf; Wufei resolves to survive and continue fighting.
decisions: Wufei's rejection of Treize targets Treize's decision to die, clarified by the following row.
Zechs names his chosen identity and renounced royal identity with their full glossary tokens.
Duo's God of Death epithet is translated as an epithet, not the unrelated glossary pilot Jin.
The gratitude and recruitment exchanges explicitly preserve who is helping and asking whom.
